abstract: A 28-years-old patient with a palpable mass of two fist's size in the upper abdomen rapidly developed an obstructive jaundice. A pancreatic tumor was suspected and therefore ERCP was carried out. Unusual alterations caused by metastatic lesions of a post mortem diagnosed testicular teratoma narrowing and invading the common bile duct and displacing the main pancreatic duct were visualized.
abstract_ja: 28歳の患者が、握りこぶし2個分の上腹部の触知可能な腫瘤を呈し、急速に閉塞性黄疸を発症した。膵腫瘍が疑われたためERCPを施行した。剖検で転移性精巣奇形腫と診断された腫瘍の転移病変により、総胆管の狭窄と浸潤、主膵管の偏位が描出された。
